replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, sometimes yes. When the concepts get too complex or abstract, I feel overwhelmed. But usually, I manage by breaking problems down into smaller steps. My low openness score means I prefer familiar methods over risky new approaches in math.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI tutor app recently. It helped explain difficult topics in simple terms and gave me practice problems. The experience was positive because it adapted to my pace without judging me, which fits my moderate agreeableness.
